page.title: Codex
page.subtitle: Manage the Codex account, model and system prompt used by the agent runner (default config profile).

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Codex needs an OpenAI API key or a ChatGPT account to run.
account.notLoggedInHint: Sign in with an API key or your ChatGPT account below.
account.apiKeyHint: Use an OpenAI API key (billed per usage).
account.chatgptHint: Sign in with your ChatGPT plan via device code: open the link and enter the code.
account.devicePending: Waiting for authorization in the browser...

model.title: Model
model.subtitle: Leave empty to use the Codex default model.
model.modelHint: Pick from the list or type a model name.
model.reasoningHint: Options depend on the selected model.
model.providerHint: Built-in OpenAI or one of the custom providers below.

voice.title: Realtime Voice
voice.subtitle: How voice conversations (Mumble voice, QQ calls) listen, talk and speak.
voice.backendBuiltinHint: An OpenAI realtime model listens and speaks; requires Codex signed in with a ChatGPT plan that includes voice.
voice.backendInfraHint: Your local-multimodal-infra server listens and speaks (VAD, recognition, TTS); a model of your choice, through Codex, does the talking. Lookups and actions go to the paired conversation's agent.
voice.realtimeModelHint: Optional. Overrides the default realtime model.
voice.infraUrlHint: The realtime WebSocket of local-multimodal-infra (/v1/realtime). Codex connects to it.
voice.infraTokenHint: Optional. One of the server's LOCAL_MCP_INFER_TOKENS.
voice.refAudioHint: Optional. A WAV file (relative paths are in the data directory, up to 8 MB) whose voice the bot speaks with; 5 to 10 seconds of clear speech. Empty: the server's default voice.
voice.refTextHint: Optional. What the reference audio says, word for word. With Qwen3-TTS on the server the voice is cloned in context (closer); the reference audio may then be at most 15 seconds. Needs the reference audio; IndexTTS ignores it.
voice.emotionHint: Used by IndexTTS-2.5 (1.5 and Qwen3-TTS ignore it).
voice.emotionStrengthHint: 0 to 1; the reference audio makes up the rest.
voice.streamTextHint: The first sentence goes to speech synthesis while the model is still writing it, so a long first sentence starts sooner. Qwen3-TTS only; with a reference transcript, speech waits until the text covers the reference audio, so it gains little.
voice.textProviderHint: Empty: the runner's provider. Pick a fast model: its first words set how quickly the bot answers.
voice.textModelHint: Empty: the runner's model. Describe third-party models under Custom Providers (context window, reasoning).
voice.textEffortHint: none turns thinking off (recommended for voice, where it only adds delay).
voice.idleCompactHint: The voice history only grows (its prefix stays cached); once the prompt passes this share of the context window, it is compacted during a quiet moment. 0: only Codex's own compaction.

providers.title: Custom providers
providers.subtitle: OpenAI-compatible endpoints exposed to Codex as model providers.
providers.name: Name
providers.compactionHint: Where long histories are compacted. Remote needs a /responses/compact endpoint (OpenAI).
providers.filesApiHint: Images from tools or messages are uploaded once to the provider's Files API (POST /files, DeepSeek's and OpenAI's shape) and later requests refer to them by file_id instead of sending them again; uploads expire after a day and are renewed before.
providers.extraBodyHint: Chat Completions only: merged over each request body's top level, for the provider's own fields (e.g. {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}); a null value removes a field Codex sends (e.g. {"reasoning_effort": null}).
providers.headersHint: Sent with every request to this provider, e.g. a session header a gateway asks for.
providers.modelsHint: Describes models Codex does not know, so it uses their real limits instead of generic defaults.
providers.metadataJsonHint: Optional. Any other Codex model info fields, over the ones above, e.g. {"support_verbosity": false}.

prompt.title: System prompt
prompt.subtitle: Instructions sent to Codex for every conversation.
prompt.baseHint: Replaces the system prompt. Leave empty to use the built-in minimal prompt.
prompt.developerHint: Extra developer-role instructions appended to the conversation (optional).
